steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Vector form: r = a + λb (line), r = a + λb + μc (plane)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Dot product: a·b = |a||b|cosθ = a₁b₁+a₂b₂+a₃b₃; perpendicular iff a·b = 0

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Cross product: axb = |a||b|sinθ n̂ = det[i j k; a₁ a₂ a₃; b₁ b₂ b₃]

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Find angle between lines r = [1; 0; -1] + λ[2; 1; 3] and r = [0; 1; 1] + μ[1; -2; 2] | Find equation of plane through (1,2,3) perpendicular to vector [2; -1; 1] | Distance from point (1,2,3) to plane 2x - 3y + 6z = 10
